title: Regioned reservations: staged launch timeline, owner matrix, and release-notes mapping
creator: Aisha Malik
summary: Coordinated go-to-market plan for staged regional reservation launches including release notes mapping, owner matrix, billing changes, and external comms.
description: Scope: Launch a staggered reservations program for three new regions (APAC-SEA, EU-North, LATAM-SAO) exposing two new compact instance families (c5x-compact, g7m-compact) and a flexible commit option. This ticket captures timeline, stakeholder owners, release-note language per audience, legal/billing checks, and cross-functional dependencies. Goal: minimize customer downtime during migration, provide clear upgrade paths for existing reservation customers, and ensure sales/CS/marketing have aligned collateral and training.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes mapped to audience tiers (self-serve, enterprise, reseller) and approved by legal
Owner matrix completed and accepted by Eng, Console, Billing, Sales, and Support
Billing migration flow validated on staging with test customers (2 accounts)
Launch checklist items completed and signed off in war-room 48 hours before region activation
Telemetry dashboards show pre-launch baselines and automated post-launch regressions alerts

risks_mitigation: Risk: Billing mismatch during migration -> Mitigation: run 3 staged test migrations and hold funds in staging account; rollback plan to reassign legacy sku.
Risk: Runtime capacity exhaustion for g7m-compact spikes -> Mitigation: feature-flag early throttling and automatic fallback to standard instance family; monitor autoscaler metrics
Risk: Release notes ambiguity -> Mitigation: 3rd party copy review + legal signoff window; maintain separate enterprise note template with migration steps
Risk: Support load spike -> Mitigation: pre-create KB articles and route triage to dedicated war-room queue for 72 hours

release_notes_draft: What's changing: We are introducing two compact instance families (c5x-compact, g7m-compact) and a flexible reservation option that lets you convert unused committed capacity into short-term burst credits. Who it affects: Customers on Reserved Capacity and new users purchasing reservations in APAC-SEA initially (rolling to EU-North and LATAM-SAO). Migration impact: Existing reservations remain valid; customers will be offered an opt-in migration flow in Console that preserves committed discount terms. Data residency: EU-North customers will see explicit data residency and audit log links in the enterprise release notes. Actions for users: Review migration guide, contact your AE for bulk migrations, and use the support war-room link for immediate issues.
followups: After APAC-SEA GA: 7-day retro to capture telemetry anomalies and customer feedback (owner: Jonah)
Coordinate with Marketing on customer-facing blog + localized messages (owner: Marta)
Prepare refund/credit policy in case of billing regressions (owner: Priya)
Schedule cross-team postmortem if >10% request failures within 48h of region activation
